questions.question: Who was the founder of the Mauryan Empire?
questions.explanation: Chandragupta Maurya was the founder of the Mauryan Empire with the help of Chanakya.

questions.question: Which Sultan built the Qutub Minar?
questions.explanation: Qutb-ud-din Aibak built the Qutub Minar.

questions.question: What was the name of the movement launched by Mahatma Gandhi in 1942?
questions.explanation: The Quit India Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in 1942.

questions.question: Who was the first woman to be elected as the President of the Indian National Congress?
questions.explanation: Sarojini Naidu was the first woman to be elected as the President of the Indian National Congress.

questions.question: Which ancient Indian dynasty built the city of Pataliputra?
questions.explanation: The Mauryan dynasty built the city of Pataliputra.

questions.question: Who was the founder of the Vijayanagara Empire?
questions.explanation: Harihara and Bukka Raya were the founders of the Vijayanagara Empire.

questions.question: What was the name of the act passed by the British in 1919 that allowed for the internment of Indians without trial?
questions.explanation: The Rowlatt Act was passed by the British in 1919 that allowed for the internment of Indians without trial.

questions.question: Who led the Salt March in 1930?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi led the Salt March in 1930.

questions.question: Which ancient Indian text is also known as the 'Song of God'?
questions.explanation: The Bhagavad Gita is also known as the 'Song of God'.

questions.question: Who was the Mughal emperor who built the Taj Mahal?
questions.explanation: Shah Jahan was the Mughal emperor who built the Taj Mahal.

questions.question: What is the largest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest state in India by area, covering approximately 342,239 square kilometers.

questions.question: Which mountain range runs along the eastern edge of India?
questions.explanation: The Purvanchal mountain range runs along the eastern edge of India, stretching from Arunachal Pradesh to Nagaland.

questions.question: Which river is the longest in South India?
questions.explanation: The Godavari is the longest river in South India, stretching approximately 1,465 kilometers from its source to its mouth.

questions.question: What is the name of the strait separating India and Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait is the strait separating India and Sri Lanka, connecting the Bay of Bengal to the Gulf of Mannar.

questions.question: Which state has the longest coastline in India?
questions.explanation: Gujarat has the longest coastline in India, with a coastline of approximately 1,600 kilometers.

questions.question: What is the name of the desert in western India?
questions.explanation: The Thar Desert is the desert in western India, covering parts of Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Punjab.

questions.question: Which city is situated on the banks of the river Yamuna?
questions.explanation: Delhi is situated on the banks of the river Yamuna, which flows through the city before joining the Ganges at Allahabad.

questions.question: What is the name of the highest peak in the Western Ghats?
questions.explanation: Anamudi is the highest peak in the Western Ghats, with an elevation of approximately 2,695 meters.

questions.question: Which state is the largest producer of coal in India?
questions.explanation: Jharkhand is the largest producer of coal in India, accounting for over 25% of the country's total coal production.

questions.question: What is the name of the largest island in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands?
questions.explanation: Andaman Island is the largest island in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, covering an area of approximately 3,212 square kilometers.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the Parliament in India?
options: To elect the President of India
To amend the Constitution of India
To make laws for the country
To appoint the Prime Minister of India
questions.explanation: The primary function of the Parliament in India is to make laws for the country, as per Article 245 of the Constitution.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a fundamental right under the Constitution of India?
questions.explanation: The Right to Property was removed as a fundamental right by the 44th Amendment Act, 1978, and is now a constitutional right under Article 300A.

questions.question: Who is the head of the Panchayati Raj system in a village?
questions.explanation: The head of the Panchayati Raj system in a village is the Sarpanch, who is the elected representative of the village.

questions.question: What is the term of office of a member of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The term of office of a member of the Rajya Sabha is 6 years, with one-third of the members retiring every 2 years.

questions.question: Which of the following is a feature of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Indian Constitution features a federal system of government, with a parliamentary system and a unitary system of government in certain aspects.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Fifth Schedule of the Constitution of India?
options: To provide for the administration of tribal areas
To provide for the administration of union territories
To provide for the administration of states
To provide for the administration of local governments
questions.explanation: The Fifth Schedule of the Constitution provides for the administration of tribal areas, including the creation of Tribal Advisory Councils.

questions.question: Who is the final interpreter of the Constitution of India?
questions.explanation: The Supreme Court of India is the final interpreter of the Constitution, as per Article 137 of the Constitution.

questions.question: What is the minimum age for a person to be eligible to vote in India?
questions.explanation: The minimum age for a person to be eligible to vote in India is 18 years, as per the Representation of the People Act, 1951.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of writ under the Constitution of India?
questions.explanation: Injunction is not a type of writ under the Constitution of India, although it is a type of remedy available under the law of torts.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Finance Commission in India?
options: To regulate the expenditure of the central government
To advise the President on financial matters
questions.explanation: The Finance Commission is established under Article 280 of the Constitution to allocate funds to states and to provide recommendations on the distribution of revenues between the center and the states.
